newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia, rivals set multimedia pact.
newsitem.headline: Nokia, rivals set multimedia pact.

text.p: Nokia, Europe's largest mobile phone maker, said on Thursday it had sealed a pact with Alcatel, Ericsson and Siemens to work towards standardising GSM-based wireless multimedia technology.

"The four companies have agreed to urge that the network structure for a future third-generation mobile system -- referred to as Universal Mobile Telecommunications System (UMTS) -- should be based on an evolved GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) network," Nokia said in a statement.
